content: Humility is the supreme ornament of knowledge; charity is the ornament of wealth; truth is the ornament of speech.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Vidya vinayena shobhate (विद्या विनयेन शोभते) — Hitopadesha
explanation: Intellect without humility is arrogant cruelty; wealth without generosity is hoarding decay; eloquence without truth is venomous deceit. The outer possession is nothing; it is the moral virtue adorning it that makes it sacred in the eyes of the cosmos.
practicalInsight: If you possess expertise in a room today, don't dominate. Wear your knowledge with quiet, gentle humility.
reflectionPrompt: Are you using your knowledge or status to elevate others or to make yourself appear superior?
